title: Usage snapshot
description: One line of usage/snapshots.jsonl in the private store (design part 12.5): a measured reading of one or more account limits at a moment. Piece (h)'s status-line command writes the rate_limits form from the Claude Code status line input; other readers (a daily Copilot figure) write readings. Internal: never leaves the machine by default.

source.description: What produced it, such as claude-code-statusline.

session.description: The harness session that fed it, if any.

rate_limits.description: The Claude Code status line's rate_limits, as given: five_hour feeds a rolling_5h limit, seven_day a weekly one.

readings.description: Readings for limits by ID, in the limit's own unit.

limit.description: A limit's ID in policy quota.limits.

resetsAt.description: When the window resets: Unix seconds (as the status line gives it) or a timestamp.
